title: 21 CFR Part 820 Quality Management System Regulation

rights.licence: Public domain: US federal regulation (17 U.S.C. 105)

source.title: 21 CFR Part 820 Quality Management System Regulation
source.identifier: 21 CFR Part 820, Title 21 up to date as of 2026-11-12

software-requirements.description: Requirements authored with the `spec-artifacts-iso` StR, FR, and NFR archetypes; rendered as the SRS by `quoin dossier generate --doc srs`.

release-record.description: Release evidence snapshot produced by `quoin release snapshot`; rendered by `quoin dossier generate --doc release-record`.

device-identification-record.description: Customer-provided device identity and UDI assignment records; no toolchain producer.

traceability-records.description: Customer-provided traceability procedures and device or batch records; no toolchain producer.

complaint-records.description: Customer-provided complaint intake, evaluation, investigation, and response records; no toolchain producer.

regulatory-report-records.description: Customer-provided records of reports to regulatory authorities; no toolchain producer.

advisory-notice-records.description: Customer-provided records of advisory notices and related actions; no toolchain producer.

software-architecture.description: `spec-objects-architecture` `part`, `port`, `connection`, and `allocation` artifacts; ADR artifacts from `spec-artifacts-process`; rendered by `quoin dossier generate --doc architecture`.

verification-records.description: `quire matrix` / `quoin matrix` results and `quoin evidence record`; rendered by `quoin dossier generate --doc verification-report` and `--doc trace-matrix`.

risk-management-records.description: `spec-objects-safety` `hazard` and `failure_mode` artifacts; `quoin risk-summary`; rendered by `quoin dossier generate --doc risk-management`.

service-records.description: Customer-provided device servicing records; no toolchain producer.

labeling-inspection-records.description: Customer-provided labeling and packaging inspection records; no toolchain producer.
